school.school_name: 北里大学看護専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a bounded official-index case where the registered disclosure page cannot be crawled because robots.txt blocks automated access.
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index disclosure URL https://www.kitasato-u.ac.jp/kango-gko/about/release.html.
Run strict FY2026 PDF discovery from the prefecture_aggregator SchoolSite.
Record the discovery_error evidence row with extra.error=robots.txt disallows all crawling.
Classify the result as a site/infrastructure failure, not as no target PDF and not as operator guesswork.

reusable_rules: Treat robots.txt or repeated fetch-block evidence as site_fetch_error when the official-index URL itself cannot be crawled.
Keep site infrastructure failures separate from no_target_candidate_found so yield analysis does not blame school publication state.
Surface the school for site-access follow-up instead of broad SERP crawling from the agent harness.
anti_patterns: Do not relabel robots-blocked official URLs as no target PDF.
Do not search the wider web before the official-index handoff failure is classified.

evidence.notes: Current-code Saitama RCA on 2026-05-11 recorded discovery_error with extra.error='robots.txt disallows all crawling' for school_id 767.
